# Dataset requests

The test rules are in `protocol.md`. These notes are the access step. Nothing is encoded until the files arrive.

## MSU screen-content set

Request form: https://forms.gle/6sRASmKQY8kR5Ryz9

Ask for the lossless references (`orig.mkv`) from the screen-content video dataset. Say the use is a course project and an optional short paper on how a few sampled frames choose one x264 quality setting for a screen recording. The provided conference-app distortions will not be used as the test encodes. Meet and Teams copies will be left out because they are not frame-aligned.

Contacts, if the form stalls: nikolay.safonov@graphics.cs.msu.ru, mihail.rakhmanov@graphics.cs.msu.ru, dmitriy@graphics.cs.msu.ru

## SCVD

Agreement: http://smartviplab.org/pubilcations/SCVD/agreement%20file.pdf

Sign it and send the scan to smartviplab@163.com. Ask for the password for the 16 reference recordings only, not the full 709 GB distortion set. The references used first are Slides, Software Installation, Word Documents, Webpage, Online Education, Game, and Animation.

Cite, if the clips are used: Shan Cheng, Huanqiang Zeng, Jing Chen, Junhui Hou, Jianqing Zhu, and Kai-Kuang Ma, “Screen Content Video Quality Assessment: Subjective and Objective Study,” IEEE Transactions on Image Processing, vol. 29, pp. 8636–8651, 2020.
